item.title: Report: Americans Pay For 96% Of Trump’s Foreign Tariffs

item.title: Syracuse Library Board Hopes To Break Ground This Spring
item.description: After two years of careful planning, the Syracuse Public Library Board of Trustees hopes to break ground on a new library this spring.

item.title: Warsaw Man Arrested For Dealing Drugs To Undercover Officers
item.description: More information has been released on the arrest of a Warsaw man after he allegedly sold drugs to undercover officers five times.

item.title: Largest US Band Manufacturer Plans To Leave Ohio, Send Some Production Overseas
item.description: While Pres. Donald Trump continues to use tariffs to push for manufacturing to return to the United States, the largest manufacturer of band instruments in the United States is leaning toward the opposite.

item.title: Parkview Kosciusko Hospital Hosting Check-Up Day Feb. 4
item.description: Parkview Kosciusko Hospital and the Parkview Center for Healthy Living, invite area residents in need of lab testing to sign up for Check-Up Day on Wednesday, Feb. 4, at the hospital, 1355 Mariners Drive, Warsaw.

item.title: Indiana Chiropractor Accused Of Sexually Assaulting Patient Loses License
item.description: Attorney General Todd Rokita’s team has ensured that a former chiropractor from the Evansville area who allegedly engaged in inappropriate sexual activity with patients - including sexually assaulting one woman - can no longer practice in Indiana.

item.title: Labcorp To Build New Facility In Brownsburg
item.description: Healthcare company Labcorp announced Tuesday, Jan. 20 a multi-year plan for a new, purpose-built, high-tech facility for its Central Laboratory Services operations in Brownsburg.
